H0: At matched total inference budget, DGC does not improve NetDecisionValue over the best preregistered baseline and does not achieve non-inferior decision quality at lower total compute cost.
H1: At matched total inference budget, DGC improves NetDecisionValue over the best preregistered baseline on the frozen synthetic oracle workload, or achieves non-inferior decision quality at lower total compute cost.
estimand: Delta NetDecisionValue = B3_DGC - max(B0_FIXED, B1_UNCERTAINTY, B2_COST_QUALITY_ROUTER), with the preregistered non-inferiority alternative evaluated separately.
decision_rule: Promote only if the preregistered uncertainty interval for the frozen primary comparison excludes zero in favor of DGC and coverage/catastrophic-regret guardrails do not fail; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED or SUPPORTED_NARROWED.
